checks.message: SITE-001 is explicitly marked provisional_constraint with official_boundary=false and never presented as an official redline.
All three named key areas are present, non-overlapping, inside SITE-001, and explicitly provisional.
The eleven conceptual land-use polygons form the submitted site partition without intended gaps or overlaps.
Known geometry values are recomputed in EPSG:4548; statutory controls retain null values and explicit pending-control reasons.
Every proposal [source:] identifier is registered with authority level, publicity, permitted use, and prohibited-use boundary.
Scenario nodes are described as voluntary, privacy-minimizing, human-reviewed, time-limited, and reversible concept tests.
The proposal repeatedly distinguishes provisional geometry from official redlines and requires full regeneration when official data arrives.
The submitted visual is a local static artifact and is not the authority for geometry or statutory controls.
The required A3 and A0 drawing deliverables are present as submitted drawing artifacts.
All thirteen proposal chapters connect design judgment to sources, standards, depth records, geometry, metrics, and disclosed gaps.
The package records its copyright statement and treats external public sources as evidence rather than package-owned assets.
